system.description: Life twists and coils where you tread. Enter the lifebinder stance. Allies within your Primal Conduit aura are healed d4 HP instead of 1 HP. Your Primal Blast binds your prey in surging roots: the target is Restrained until it succeeds on a Strength test (DR12).

effects.note: lifebinder stance: allies in your Primal Conduit aura heal d4 instead of 1, and your Primal Blast Restrains its target until it passes a Strength test (DR12)
